handoffs.message: Wave 3 implementation complete. EV-01/EV-02/EV-03/EV-04/LN-01/TL-03/IN-04 + post-incident composed view all implemented and verified. Committed as 22dd32f.

Changes requested: post-incident review should use TL-03 performance by artifact_id (not telemetry_summary + affected_persona_id) and should return real lineage edges or mark LN-01 degraded. See services/control-plane/bff/review_app002_w3_postincident_codex.md.
Ready for review. All acceptance criteria met — post-incident view, evolution surfaces, lineage & telemetry evidence shaped. Tests pass. Added LN-02/03, TL-01/02 endpoints.

Review approved. All acceptance criteria verified: (1) post-incident review composed view properly composes IN-04, EV-01/EV-02, LN-01, TL-03 with surface status metadata; (2) evolution surfaces EV-01 through EV-04 all live with filter support; (3) lineage LN-01/02/03 and telemetry TL-01/02/03 endpoints complete. New endpoints match BFF_API_CONTRACT.md shapes. Unit tests 38/38 pass.

Review approved. All acceptance criteria verified: post-incident view live, evolution surfaces EV-01–EV-04 live, lineage LN-01/02/03 + telemetry TL-01/02/03 endpoints complete. 38/38 unit tests pass.
